item.tib: glu ru zhi ba'i gsang bskangs rin chen gter rgyun
item.coloph: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ brag dmar yer pa'i rdzong la mdzad nas su/ yum chen mkha' 'gro ma la gnyer du gtad/ de nas dus dang las kyi (kyis) dbang bsgyur nas/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor bdag la brnyesnyen (snyan) du brgyud/ bdag gis sbas dang gsang rgya thub par byas/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ kar (dkar) chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyong srung ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i 'gro kun bla med sa thob shog/
